properties.title: Piqua WWTP
properties.summary: City of Piqua WWTP (NPDES 1PD00008 / OH0027049), outfall 001 to the Great Miami River (→ Ohio River; HUC-8 05080001, Upper Great Miami). Average design flow 8.7 MGD [Ohio EPA NPDES fact sheet 1PD00008, PN 22-006-011, 2022-06-21]. WLA design low flow: GMR-above-Sidney 7Q10 24.0 cfs (USGS 03261500).
